aboutGame.title: What is Roco Kingdom?
paragraphs: Roco Kingdom is an open-world creature-collecting RPG from Morefun Studios. Players explore the seamless continent of Carosia, meet and catch more than 400 unique Jinies, build a team, and take part in turn-based PvP where levels are equalized.

Beyond exploration, Roco Kingdom includes co-op riding and shared rewards, Magic Academy classes, home building, and an 18-class elemental counter system. The global closed beta, called the Quack Quack Test, is scheduled for October 27, 2026 on PC, iOS, and Android.

items.question: What is Roco Kingdom?
items.answer: Roco Kingdom is an open-world creature-collecting RPG from Morefun Studios. It takes place on the continent of Carosia, where players catch and train more than 400 unique Jinies, explore with friends, and battle in turn-based PvP with equalized levels.

items.question: Which Roco Kingdom starter should beginners choose?
items.answer: The Water starter has the widest margin for error, while the Fire starter clears early fights faster and the Nature starter offers sustain and control. Choose the Roco Kingdom starter that matches your planned team and playstyle.

items.question: How do Roco Kingdom Jinies evolve?
items.answer: Each Roco Kingdom Jinie follows a defined evolution line with its own trigger, such as a level, item, bond, or condition. Read the full line, bank the required item, and remember that most evolutions are permanent.

items.question: When does Roco Kingdom launch?
items.answer: The Roco Kingdom Quack Quack Test closed beta begins on October 27, 2026 at 04:30 UTC for PC, iOS, and Android. A global launch date and open beta window have not been announced.

items.question: Can I play Roco Kingdom with friends?
items.answer: Yes. Roco Kingdom supports co-op riding, shared gathering rewards, shared battle EXP, cross-platform play, and turn-based PvP duels with an 18-class elemental counter system.
